caption:
Retail sales just posted a 13th straight monthly gain. 🛍️

The CNBC/NRF Retail Monitor says October sales rose 0.15% from September and 3.57% from a year ago.
The NRF says households are "managing budgets carefully" and timing purchases around sales.

Are you waiting for Black Friday this year?
